mapper.sql: contract_id, previous_contract_id, creditor_id, debtor_id, principal_amount, interest_rate, repayment_type, start_date, maturity_date, repayment_day, status, creditor_address, debtor_address, contract_alias, terms, creditor_signature, debtor_signature, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_contract ( creditor_id, creditor_name, creditor_birth_date, creditor_address, principal_amount, interest_rate, repayment_type, start_date, maturity_date, repayment_day, contract_alias, terms, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{user.userId}, #{user.name}, #{user.birthDate}, #{request.creditorAddress}, #{request.principalAmount}, #{request.interestRate}, #{request.repaymentType}, #{request.startDate}, #{request.maturityDate}, #{request.repaymentDay}, #{request.contractAlias}, #{request.terms}, 'DRAFT', NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO loan_contract_file( contract_id, original_filename, saved_filename, file_size, file_type, created_at ) VALUES ( #{contractId}, #{originalFilename}, #{savedFilename}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT file_id AS fileId, contract_id AS contractId, original_filename AS originalFilename, saved_filename AS savedFilename, file_size AS fileSize, file_type AS fileType, created_at AS createdAt FROM loan_contract_file WHERE contract_id = #{contractId}
